facts.text: Fred's dad wants him out of the house by Easter Sunday
facts.why: The transcript has Fred's parents telling him to get a job and move out, and Wikipedia says they forced him out. No Easter Sunday deadline or line from his dad alone.
facts.fix: Fred's parents want him out and into a job
